office: Representative, Maguindanao del Norte Lone District
role: District Representative · Maguindanao del Norte, Lone District
summary: Maguindanao del Norte representative with 104 principal-authored bills. Authored a prohibition on online gambling, protection of rape victims from marriages to offenders, amendments to the Cybercrime Prevention Act, National Internal Revenue Code amendments, higher barangay official retirement pay and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Social score nets a vice-regulation bill against a gender-protection bill, so it is only weakly positive. Cybercrime amendment direction was not reviewed, so civil liberties is not scored.
